reason: I run everything on WhatsApp and UPI. A new login, an app, and teaching my staff to punch in a PIN for every coupon is more work than I want for creators who mostly just want free food anyway.
objection: It's one more app and sign-in to manage, and my staff at the counter won't bother with the PIN step on a busy day, so the customer counter will be wrong and I'll stop using it.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked fully over WhatsApp, no app or Google login, and the coupon check was just a UPI-style scan or a WhatsApp message my staff already know how to do.
